Refunds worked through this chat before.

text: Confirmed the middleware only adds delegation tools for agents listed in the config, so the fix is adding 'refundAgent' to that agents list in the single configuration line. I'm weighing whether to verify by running it, but CLAUDE.md says I shouldn't execute genkit commands myself.
The middleware only injects delegation tools for agents named in its `agents` list, so `refundAgent` is never reachable from triage. I'll add it to the list.
I'm preparing the answer file, extracting the exact broken line with the agents configuration call to use as the verbatim snippet, trimming leading whitespace to keep it safe as a substring match.
Type-check passes. Now I'll write `answer.json` in the project root.

The root cause is in `src/agents.ts`: the `triage` agent's `agents()` middleware lists only `orderAgent` as a delegation target. Triage therefore has no tool to hand refund requests to `refundAgent`, which is where the `approveRefund` interrupt lives. Order-status questions still work because `orderAgent` is listed.

I changed that line to `agents: ['orderAgent', 'refundAgent']`. `tsc --noEmit` passes. I did not run the chat end to end, since that needs a live model call.

`answer.json` is written to the project root with `file`, the replaced `snippet`, `cause`, and `evidence`. `package.json` is unchanged.
